acceptance_signals: A compact relationship map appears before the detailed reading material and shows the source-faithful sequence from referenced dependency to declared event identity to accountable-producer observed fact to exact-name membership evaluation.

Three clearly differentiated panels explain the roles of repository-relative paths, declared invalidating event identifiers, and observed event identities without presenting a question answer key, score, automatic pass/fail, or facilitator coaching.
The complete friendly record and specification reading layers and both exact-source audit disclosures remain available and source-parity tests continue to pass.
Tests protect the new concept-map structure, source-faithful terminology, correct no-automatic-discovery boundary, responsive behavior, and existing no-persistence/no-answer-submission boundaries.
The standalone site build and supported Python 3.11 suite pass, the existing public Sites URL is updated, and the final response contains the concept-map markers and noindex directive.
Task/repository governance, scope reconciliation, privacy scanning, diff validation, status closeout, and an evidence-bounded current-Agent advisory review are recorded.

decision.rationale: The accountable human reviewed structured proposal prp-eedefa814ead40b08fb14a6bccb0bc2e and admitted that exact task through an explicit admission control.

requirement.summary: Add a concise pre-question concept map to the existing Evidence Freshness rehearsal that distinguishes referenced paths, declared invalidating event identifiers, producer-supplied observed events, and exact-name matching; preserve the complete friendly source material and exact audit disclosures; update the existing public test URL.

items: A concept map may become an answer key rather than a conceptual explanation.
Overfitting the interface to one participant could hide different comprehension problems.
Removing or collapsing source material could regress the source-completeness requirement.
The public URL remains discoverable despite noindex metadata.
Pre-existing prior-task and user-owned working-copy changes must remain outside this task.
The Sites source commit/push is limited to the existing Sites-managed source destination and does not authorize a parent-repository commit or push.
Reviewed assumption: The user's approval refers to the concrete relationship-map and three-category presentation proposed immediately before this request.
Reviewed assumption: The existing public URL and public access mode should be reused without changing access policy.
Reviewed assumption: The complete friendly source and exact audit layers remain part of the measured page; the new map changes information hierarchy rather than deleting source facts.
Reviewed assumption: A CSS/HTML relationship map is sufficient and avoids unrelated image or application-architecture changes.
Reviewed assumption: The prior participant result is product evidence for this bounded revision but is not generalized as proof about all users.
Reviewed unknown: Whether a second genuinely unbriefed participant will distinguish paths from event identifiers after the revision remains unknown.
Reviewed unknown: Whether the concept map unintentionally over-coaches individual answers remains a later participant-review question.
Reviewed unknown: Whether the longer source material still creates excessive scrolling in the participant's live browser remains unknown.

title: Clarify evidence paths, events, and exact-match flow
